question: If a denser pool put a candidate within <1° of truth at the solve anchors, do the connectability ω-dir error and the windowed-RMSE discriminator both work on seed 116?
hypothesis: At <1° geodesic distance the connecting ω-dir error drops below the s087 1.25° gate AND windowed RMSE separates from junk.
narrative_md: Forward-model basin probe placing candidates at controlled geodesic distance δ from truth at the solve anchors. Decisive: at δ<1° truth-near windowed RMSE is ~0.01-0.03 mag, 100% below the junk floor (0.109), and 100% of candidates have ω-dir<1.25°. Both levers degrade through δ≈2-3° — exactly the gap a 30k pool gives — explaining the s092/s093 marginality. Density is the lever; the discriminator works once a candidate is within ~1-1.5°. Places candidates relative to truth → not blind.
